# ============================================================
# Notebook: Decking History Status Enrichment
# Environment: Azure Synapse Analytics (PySpark)
# ============================================================

# ── 1. Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────
storage_account = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
container       = "apmt-elz"
base_path       = f"abfss://{container}@{storage_account}.dfs.core.windows.net"

moves_path    = f"{base_path}/silver/moves"
deckings_path = f"{base_path}/silver/deckings"
output_path   = f"{base_path}/export/deckings_status"

# ── 2. Load Data ─────────────────────────────────────────────
df_moves    = spark.read.parquet(moves_path)
df_deckings = spark.read.parquet(deckings_path)

# Preview schemas — review and adjust column names below if needed
print("=== Move History Schema ===")
df_moves.printSchema()

print("=== Decking History Schema ===")
df_deckings.printSchema()

# ── 3. Column Name Configuration ─────────────────────────────
# !! ADJUST THESE to match your actual column names !!

DECKING_CONTAINER_COL  = "unit_id"    # container number in deckings
DECKING_TIMESTAMP_COL  = "time_stamp"  # timestamp in deckings

MOVE_CONTAINER_COL     = "Unit_Nbr"    # container number in moves
MOVE_TIMESTAMP_COL     = "t_put"            # timestamp in moves
MOVE_STATUS_COL        = "Freight_Kind_Id"           # status column in moves
MOVE_CATEGORY_COL  = "Category_Id"
MOVE_KIND_COL      = "Move_Kind"
MOVE_GKEY_COL      = "mve_gkey"

# ── 4. Cast Timestamps (safety) ──────────────────────────────
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

df_moves = df_moves.withColumn(
    MOVE_TIMESTAMP_COL,
    F.col(MOVE_TIMESTAMP_COL).cast("timestamp")
)

df_deckings = df_deckings.withColumn(
    DECKING_TIMESTAMP_COL,
    F.col(DECKING_TIMESTAMP_COL).cast("timestamp")
)

# ── 5. Add Surrogate Key to Deckings ─────────────────────────
# Needed to preserve each individual decking row after the join
df_deckings = df_deckings.withColumn(
    "_decking_id",
    F.monotonically_increasing_id()
)

# ── 6. Join Decking → Move History ───────────────────────────
# Join on container number, then filter: t_put > decking timestamp

df_joined = df_deckings.alias("d").join(
    df_moves.alias("m"),
    on=(
        F.col(f"d.{DECKING_CONTAINER_COL}") == F.col(f"m.{MOVE_CONTAINER_COL}")
    ),
    how="left"
).filter(
    # Keep only move records that occurred AFTER the decking event
    # (null-safe: rows with no match are kept via left join)
    F.col(f"m.{MOVE_TIMESTAMP_COL}").isNull() |
    (F.col(f"m.{MOVE_TIMESTAMP_COL}") > F.col(f"d.{DECKING_TIMESTAMP_COL}"))
)

# ── 7. Pick Earliest Qualifying Move per Decking Row ─────────
# Window: for each unique decking row, rank move records by t_put ascending

window_spec = Window.partitionBy(
    F.col("d._decking_id")           # one partition per decking row
).orderBy(
    F.col(f"m.{MOVE_TIMESTAMP_COL}").asc_nulls_last()  # earliest t_put first
)

df_ranked = df_joined.withColumn("_move_rank", F.row_number().over(window_spec))

# Keep only rank 1 = the earliest qualifying move (or the null row if no match)
df_best_match = df_ranked.filter(F.col("_move_rank") == 1)

# ── 8. Build Final Output ─────────────────────────────────────
decking_cols = [
    F.col(f"d.{c}").alias(c)
    for c in df_deckings.columns
    if c != "_decking_id"
]

df_result = df_best_match.select(
    *decking_cols,
    F.col(f"m.{MOVE_STATUS_COL}").alias("status"),
    F.col(f"m.{MOVE_CATEGORY_COL}").alias("Category_Id"),   # ← new
    F.col(f"m.{MOVE_KIND_COL}").alias("Move_Kind"),         # ← new
    F.col(f"m.{MOVE_GKEY_COL}").alias("mve_gkey"),          # ← new
)

print(f"Output row count: {df_result.count()}")
df_result.show(10, truncate=False)

# ── 9. Write Output as CSV ────────────────────────────────────
df_result.coalesce(1).write \
    .mode("overwrite") \
    .option("header", "true") \
    .csv(output_path)

print(f"✅ Written to: {output_path}")
